name: Nikki Global Finance Limited
about: Nikki Global Finance Limited, a credit institution, engages in the provision of various debt products to corporates and individuals in India. It offers secured corporate lending in the form of secured term loans for capital expenditure, working capital, and brownfield/greenfield expansions; loans at project level for the construction of commercial and residential properties primarily in the form of last mile financing for near completion properties; and loans against gold and listed shares. The company also provides special situations funding for various purposes, such as acquisitions, buyouts, bridge financing, and creeping takeover; debt financing solutions for corporate borrowers; secured promoter funding; purchase of secured consumer loan pools; and co-lending services. Nikki Global Finance Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in New Delhi, India.
